VS

full_judgment:
2. The facts relevant for disposal of the Rule, in short, are that the opposite party Most. Kalpana Bibi wife of the petitioner Md Rafiqul Islam filed a family suit being No. 13 of 1997 for realization of dower money and maintenance of herself and her two minor sons and obtained decree on 4-7-2006 and thereby directed the judgment-debtor Md Rafiqul Islam to pay Taka 25,970 within 90 days from the date of decree passed on 26-4-2000 as decreetal amount and further directed to pay Taka 200 for each son for every month as maintenance. Thereafter, the said Md Rafiqul Islam filed a Civil Revision No. 1718 of 2002 before the Hon'ble High Court Division and he was directed to pay 50% of the decreetal amount to the opposite party on 20-4-2002. Thereafter, he surrendered in the family court without paying the said 50% amount of the decreetal amount. The trial court then passed an order for imprisonment for a term of 3 (three) months which was served out by him. Subsequently, the opposite party Most. Kalpana Bibi filed Family Execution Case No. 3 of 2003. On the basis of an exemption petition filed by the petitioner Rafiqul Islam, the Family Court, Bogra on 29-11-2004 allowed the said petition and exempted the petitioner and rejected the Execution Case No. 3 of 2003 on the ground that the judgment-debtor Rafiqul Islam has served out 3 (three) months sentence and the execution case is barred by limitation since it was not filed within one year as stipulated in section 16(3) of the Family Court Ordinance, 1985. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the order dated 29-11-2004 passed by the Family Court, Bogra, the opposite party Most. Kalpana Bibi filed an appeal being No. 7 of 2005. On appeal, the learned Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Bogra allowed the appeal on 27-6-2006 and set-aside the order dated 29-11-2004 restoring the Execution Case No. 3 of 2003 in its original file and number. On being aggrieved and dissatisfied with the judgment and decree of the appellate court, the petitioner Md Rafiqul Islam filed this revision and obtained the instant Rule from this Court. 

 5. I have perused the records meticulously and found that the opposite party Most. Kalpana Bibi filed a Family Case No. 13 of 1997 in the Family Court, Bogra and obtained decree against which Civil Revision No. 1718 of 2002 was filed wherein the petitioner Rafiqul Islam was directed on 20-4-2002 to pay 50% of the decreetal amount. Admittedly the petitioner did not pay the said 50% and rest of the decreetal amount to the opposite party Most. Kalpana Bibi. Thereafter, she filed the Execution Case No. 3 of 2003 within one year from the date.pf last order passed by the Hon'ble High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 1718 of 2002. Under such circumstances the learned Joint District, Judge, 2nd Court, Bogra rightly decided that: the opposite party Most. Kalpana Bibi filed the Execution Case within the period of limitation (one year).
